title: A repository dossier, inferred from the repository's own files
description: data/dossiers/<repo>.json, one per original public repository of data/index.json, checked by scripts/check-dossiers.mjs (rule project.dossiers-inferred). A dossier is inferred: an agent read the files named in sources.read at sources.commit on sources.read_at and wrote the problem, the solution, the stack and an architecture diagram, in English and Czech, with its confidence. It names no client, person or private source (rule project.nda-never-named); related names only other original repositories.

repo.description: The repository's name in data/index.json; the file is data/dossiers/<repo>.json.

sources.description: Provenance: where and when the dossier was read. A dossier is re-mined when the repository's head moves past commit.

commit.description: The head commit the files were read at.

read.description: Repository-relative paths of the files read.

provenance.description: Every dossier is inferred and is labelled so wherever it is shown.

mermaid.description: A Mermaid flowchart, LR or TD, of 4 to 12 nodes, with no HTML and no click, style, class or init directives.

confidence.description: How much of the repository the reader could verify.

text.description: The same text in every language of the site.
